title: Optimize Console: recommendation insights cards, safe-diff preview, and apply playback
creator: Alyssa Chen
description: Purpose: Build the user experience in Console > Optimize that surfaces automated batching and caching recommendations as compact 'insight cards', allows users to preview exact configuration diffs before applying changes, and provides a tamper-evident apply history / playback audit trail for every change. Goals: 1) help engineers safely reduce token/unit cost with negotiable risk controls, 2) make rollbacks trivial and auditable, 3) provide simulation-backed savings estimates so teams can trust recommendations. Scope: - Recommendation cards in Recommendations feed with: short rationale, estimated monthly savings (USD), confidence band, risk score, sample workload impact, and primary action buttons (Preview Diff, Simulate, Apply Draft). - Diff preview modal: side-by-side old vs new runtime config (batch size, cache TTL, routing policy, quantization profile), estimated impact on latency and throughput, list of affected routes, and quick validation errors. - Apply flow: Apply as Draft or Apply to Production with canary rollout options (percentage of traffic and time window), and required approver step for high-risk changes. - Apply history and audit trail: immutable entries with who, when, config snapshot, metrics snapshot (cost/latency/error rate), associated PR/Run ID, and one-click revert which opens a reverse-diff that can be applied as a rollback. - Telemetry: events for view/preview/simulate/apply/revert with simulation results and runtime metric deltas stored for regressions and ML model retraining. Acceptance criteria: - PM/Design/Eng sign-off on recommendation card visual spec and diff semantics. - Diff preview displays every config key that changes and a machine-readable JSON blob available for engineers to download. - Canary apply supports at least 3 rollout percentages (1%, 10%, 100%) and records observed metric deltas after rollout. - Audit trail entries are queryable by timeframe and user and include links to associated simulation runs and GitHub PR if change was applied via PR. - UX performance: opening preview or history should be <600ms on Console internal network. Success metrics: - 20% of recommendations previewed by users click Simulate. - 10% of simulated recommendations are applied in draft or production within 7 days. - Average cost per token across customers with Optimize enabled reduced by 8% after rollout. Trade-offs and decisions: - We will show a simplified summary on the card and a full diff in the modal to avoid overwhelming non-technical users. - Confidence bands derive from sampling historical request traces; we will surface uncertainty to avoid overpromising. - Full config editing is out of scope for this ticket; edits are limited to accepting the suggested payload or applying a rollback. Backend work: API endpoints for simulation runs, apply/diff snapshots, audit log storage, and secure revert operations are tracked in ENG-2101 and ENG-2150. Rollout plan: - Week 1: Design finalization and API contract with ENG. - Week 2: Implementation of card UI, diff modal, and basic apply flow behind feature flag. - Week 3: Canary rollout to internal customers + telemetry validation. - Week 4: Public launch and documentation update.
